gate_results.rationale: Selected vendor Fluxbridge Labs C2D29-4 passes mandatory RFP criteria (mandatory_criteria_failed=0), sanctions screening is clear, and due diligence is complete, so PROC-MAND-001, PROC-SAN-001/002 and PROC-DD-001 do not apply. TCO 3y of 2,351,128 EUR is well below the purchasing envelope of 7,000,000 EUR (1.5x threshold = 10,500,000), so PROC-BUDGET-001 does not apply. The only applicable finding is PROC-REF-001: references_checked=false for the selected supplier. This is a risk-acceptable medium finding, so a conditional GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS under the standing mandate (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) is appropriate, with the action CHECK_VENDOR_REFERENCES.

Applying the legal decision policy to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot: (1) LEGAL-SIGN-001 applies because signing_authority_valid=false — the proposed signatory lacks recorded authority (critical, SUSPENSION, risk_acceptance_allowed=false). (2) LEGAL-AUDIT-001 applies because audit_right='reports_only', which is insufficient for this Critical service and below the playbook requirement of 'full or limited' (high, REWORK, risk-acceptable). Other predicates do not fire: personal_data=false and dpa_status='not_required' (no DPA finding); liability_cap_multiplier='unlimited' (not 0.5); exit_assistance_days=60 (not 0); ip_ownership='customer' (not ambiguous); insurance_valid=true; log_export_clause='included'. The non-authoritative MSA is consistent on the audit clause ('reports_only') and signing position, though it shows stale values for exit assistance (61 days) and log export ('missing'); the authoritative snapshot governs. The highest-severity applicable finding (LEGAL-SIGN-001) mandates SUSPENSION, which requires authorization under the standing mandate (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) — the critical signatory finding is not risk-acceptable, so it cannot be conditionally approved. Actions are proposed remediation only, not completed.

Applying the compliance decision policy to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE snapshot: (1) COMP-RESID-001 applies because residency_compliant=false — required_residency is 'UK' but the authoritative DATA_INVENTORY shows actual_region 'North Europe' for the Core business data dataset, a critical violation (NO_GO, risk_acceptance_allowed=false). (2) COMP-EXPORT-002 applies because export_control='pending' (high, SUSPENSION, risk_acceptance_allowed=false). Other predicates do not fire: dpia_required=false and dpia_status='not_required' (no DPIA finding); audit_trail='partial' (not 'missing'); regulatory_mapping='partial' (not 'missing'); accessibility_status='pass'; export_control is not 'restricted'. The highest-severity applicable finding (COMP-RESID-001, critical) mandates NO_GO, which requires authorization under the standing mandate (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) — neither finding is risk-acceptable, so conditional approval is not available. Actions are proposed remediation only, not completed remediation.

Applying the security decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot at the design-phase Security Architecture Gate: (1) SEC-NET-001 applies — the project's data_classification is 'Confidential' and private_endpoints=false, so sensitive data services (Azure SQL Managed Instance, Storage, Key Vault, API Management) are reachable over public networks. AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH corroborates with 'private_endpoints': false and publicNetworkAccess true on the data services. This is critical with disposition NO_GO and risk_acceptance_allowed=false. (2) SEC-VULN-001 applies — critical_vulns_open=1, corroborated by VULN_SCAN showing CVE-2026-8000 (Critical, Open). Critical, NO_GO, not risk-acceptable. Other predicates do not fire: internet_exposed=true but waf_present=true and WAF_POLICY mode='Prevention' (not detection-only), so SEC-WAF-001/002 do not apply; mfa='mandatory' so SEC-IAM-001 does not apply; shared_service_principal=false so SEC-IAM-002 does not apply; logs_to_siem=true so SEC-LOG-001 does not apply; phase='design' (not build_acceptance) so SEC-PENTEST-001 does not apply; key_rotation_days=60 (not None/365) so SEC-KEY-001 does not apply. The highest-severity applicable findings are both critical and mandate NO_GO, which requires authorization under the standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-04-SECURITY-1 (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings); neither finding is risk-acceptable, so conditional approval is not available. Proposed actions are remediation proposals only, not completed remediation.

Applying the IT decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot at the build_acceptance IT Gate: (1) IT-EOL-001 applies — technology_eol_months=4, below the 12-month threshold, corroborated by LIFECYCLE_REGISTER showing eol_months "4" for technology container_apps (high, REWORK, risk-acceptable). (2) IT-CMDB-001 applies — cmdb_record_present=false in the build_acceptance phase, corroborated by CMDB_EXPORT with record_present "False" (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptable). (3) IT-CAPACITY-001 applies — capacity_headroom_pct=8, below the 15% threshold, in the build_acceptance phase, corroborated by LIFECYCLE_REGISTER (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptable). Predicates that do not fire: catalog_status="standard" and waiver_present=true (TECH_CATALOG confirms catalog_status "standard", waiver_present true), so IT-CATALOG-001 does not apply; duplicate_capability=false, so IT-RATIONAL-001 does not apply; license_compliant=true (LICENSE_POSITION confirms "license_compliant": "True"), so IT-LICENSE-001 does not apply; run_owner_present=true (SUPPORT_RACI records run owner Amira Nguyen-12002-SO), so IT-RUN-001 does not apply; change_record_status="draft" but phase is build_acceptance, not deployment_closure, so IT-CHANGE-001 does not apply. The highest-severity applicable finding (IT-EOL-001, high) mandates REWORK, so the overall disposition is REWORK. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO), so no authorization is required and no conditional approval is available or needed. Proposed actions are remediation proposals only, not completed remediation.

Applying the general decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL snapshot at the governance-phase General Gate: (1) GEN-STRAT-001 applies — strategic_alignment='weak' (high, SUSPENSION, risk-acceptable). (2) GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO applies — UPSTREAM_DECISIONS shows two upstream gates returned NO_GO (BUY-03-COMPLIANCE-1 and BUY-04-SECURITY-1), so the critical upstream-NO_GO predicate fires (NO_GO, risk_acceptance_allowed=false). Predicates that do not fire: budget_requested_eur=7000000 is not greater than budget_approved_eur=7700000, so GEN-BUDGET-001 does not apply; roi=0.344 is not below 0.05, so GEN-BC-001 does not apply; phase='governance' (not deployment_closure), so GEN-BENEFITS-001 does not apply. The highest-severity applicable finding (GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO, critical) mandates NO_GO. NO_GO requires authorization under the standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-06-GENERAL-1 (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings); the critical upstream-NO_GO finding is not risk-acceptable, so conditional approval is not available. Proposed actions are remediation proposals only, not completed remediation.
